label: last copy step of length-3 sequences (outputting 3rd token)
explanation: Copy-phase only; never fires in original or delimiter phases, and never on the first occurrence of a token. 69% of activation mass is at the final step (t=5) of L=3 sequences, where the input is the 2nd original token fed back and the model outputs the 3rd; about 62% of such steps are active. Magnitude is strongly modulated by the input token: the top activations (near max) all have input r, i, l or s at that step (restricting to r/i/l/s/a/y gives ~97% precision but only 34% of mass). Smaller tails: L=3 t=4, L=4 last steps, and late copy steps of long sequences (e.g. L=9 t=17, t=12), again mostly with input r/i/l/s. These tails are not captured, so recall is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: r, i, l, s, y, a; least: u, z, q, 1) and the token being output (most: g, c, r, n, i, l; least: u, v, k, -); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, L=3, t=5.
